html:
Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is a Brazilian politician, president of Brazil from 2003 to 2010 and again from 2023. A former metalworker, he is the dominant figure of the Brazilian left.

Born into a poor family in Pernambuco, he moved to São Paulo as a child and became a union leader, leading strikes against the military regime in 1978 to 1980. He founded the Workers' Party in 1980. After losing three elections, he won in 2002.

In his first presidency, high commodity prices and programmes such as Bolsa Família lifted tens of millions out of poverty. He left office very popular. Later he was convicted of corruption in the Car Wash investigation and jailed in 2018; the Supreme Court annulled the verdicts in 2021. He beat Jair Bolsonaro in 2022 to return as president of Brazil.
sum: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is a Brazilian politician, president of Brazil from 2003 to 2010 and again from 2023. A former metalworker, he is the dominant figure of the Brazilian left.
